title: Builtbyswami Weekly #3: Sony kills the disc, Apple rents you a phone, and open AI catches up
teaser: Sony sets an end date for PlayStation discs, Apple tests a lease-to-own iPhone program, open-source AI has its best week yet with Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4, Google locks in its August 12 Pixel reveal, and July's ugliest breaches needed zero hacking skill.
